name: takeoffmetric
description: Read-only lookup of the TakeoffMetric US construction estimating constants (dataset 1.2.0): 148 records with unit, SI conversion, condition and source; 55 values withheld at their publishers' request. Computes nothing.
releasenote: First release: port of takeoffmetric-go, dataset 1.2.0 (148 records, 55 withheld); byID, search, all, sources, csv.
